phaseNote: READ-ONLY investigation. No repository files were modified.
scope: budgetMin/budgetRecommended/budgetMax/budgetBreakdown on 978 destinations; 413 records in 18 repeated-value clusters; 227 no-budget records

semantics.budgetMin_budgetMax: PER-PERSON daily estimate - DestinationCard.tsx renders [budgetMin*partySize, budgetMax*partySize]; Explore filter thresholds use budgetMax per person
semantics.budgetRecommended: per-person midpoint; pipeline.cjs + normalize-destination-budgets.ts enforce round((min+max)/2) and rescale breakdown to sum==recommended
semantics.budgetBreakdown: per-person daily components (transport=local transit allowance, tickets=admission, food, cafe); calculateItemizedTripCost multiplies tickets/cafe by partySize
semantics.semanticConflict: getAdjustedBudget() and getEstimatedBudgetRange() still treat recommended/breakdown as COUPLE-scale (otherCostsCouple = rec - transport, /2*partySize; scale=partySize/2) - stale code contradicting DestinationCard + calculateItemizedTripCost; code-level fix, not data
semantics.transportNote: breakdown.transport is an ON-SITE local-transit allowance, NOT origin round-trip fare; widget replaces it with origin fares when a mode is active
semantics.admissionVsBudget: budget totals include food/cafe/transport on top of admission; admission alone must not be compared to budgetMin/Max

clusterClassification.rootCause: d1f36940 (v1.9.2, 2026-07-29) + 8341eb96 (v1.7.62 catalog sync, 2026-07-28): identical hub budget stamped on all city/ward/town/village hubs; 114/119 already identical in d1f36940

d1f36940 template variant after repair pass (FREE_PLACE_TICKET_COST rule): tickets forced 0, cafe rebalanced +800 (400->1200); tickets=0 correct only for genuinely free venues

d1f36940 template variant after repair pass: tickets forced 0, transport/food rebalanced (1300/2300/400); venues are free-to-enter public spaces -> tickets=0 largely correct; several kind labels wrong (Dotonbori/Fushimi Inari/Canal City marked museum)
d1f36940: same createDestination() formula with indoorPercent>=70: min 3000, rec 5500, max 8500, breakdown {1925,1100,1925,550}
8341eb96-era standalone template: min, rec=min+2250, max=rec+2250, NO breakdown; runtime getEffectiveBudgetBreakdown() fabricates breakdown (transport 3000, tickets 1500/2000, food/cafe 65/35%)
clusterClassification.editorialNote: no breakdown; runtime fabricates - add breakdown or hasBudget=false

clusterClassification.rootCause: d1f36940-era UNESCO/major-site template {4000,9500,15000, 3000/2000/3000/1500}; tickets 2000 formulaic - many sites free (Ogasawara, Shirakami) or 500-1500 (Horyuji 1500, Tomioka 1000, Western Art 500)
pr12c-kyushu-expansion.ts buildPoi() formula: breakdown = {35%, ticketCost, 40%, 10% of budgetMin} -> sum 850 != rec 3000 (formula bug: uses min not rec)
kai-57-tohoku-expansion.ts template [0,1500,3000] + {800,0,500,200} (exact match line 1169-1170); min=0 for free-entry sites
d1f36940 template {9000,13000,17000, 1083/8667/2275/975}; tickets 8667 (67% of rec) nonsense for free districts Ikebukuro/Odaiba; roughly plausible for Yomiuriland day pass (real 5900)

validators.rule: sum(breakdown) must equal budgetRecommended (or be absent)
budgetRecommended must equal round((budgetMin+budgetMax)/2); pipeline.cjs auto-fixes at build; source index currently deviates (C1/C2/C3/C4/C13/C15/C17)
identical full budget tuple shared by >=5 records across >=2 prefectures -> template suspect
budgetBreakdown.tickets==0 on a venue with verified paid admission (22 verified wrong in this audit)
tickets equals formulaic template value (800/1100/1300/2000/8667) -> verify against official admission
role=hub budgets identical across hubs; per-hub editorial budget required
records without budgetBreakdown get runtime-fabricated breakdown (getEffectiveBudgetBreakdown); add explicit breakdown or hasBudget=false
hasBudget=false on venues with official admission prices (castles/museums/gardens/temples/caves) - add budget with verified tickets
code-level: getAdjustedBudget/getEstimatedBudgetRange use couple-scale math while UI uses per-person - pick one scale
